releases.body:
Initial public release.

- Filters `/models` to the `opencode` and `opencode-go` catalogs' published 0-day retention models.
- Refreshes live policies every 12 hours with a 30-day cache and bundled snapshot fallback.
- Supports `showUnknown`, `providers`, `refreshHours`, and `verifiedZdr` options.
- Expired conditional zeros and stale snapshot zeros are never selectable, even with `showUnknown: true`.

Install:

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-zdr-models
```

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-zdr-models
